title: How to update
summary: When new patches come out, patch BaconReader again with Reseam Manager: Android updates the app and keeps your login and settings.
body:
- Reseam Manager gets the new patches when it starts, but doesn't patch BaconReader again by itself.
- Then, under **Patched apps**, tap **BaconReader Premium** (or **BaconReader**), then **Patch again**, then **Install → Update**. Reseam Manager patches its own copy of the APK you picked the first time: you don't need to keep the APK.
- The bottom of BaconReader's left menu shows which patches are installed, such as "Patches 0.1.20 (Reseam 0.40.0)".
caption: Reseam Manager updates BaconReader Premium to the newest BaconReader patches
recorded: Recorded on a Pixel 6 Pro with Reseam Manager 0.41.0.
gherkin:
@phone
Scenario: Reseam Manager updates BaconReader Premium to the newest BaconReader patches
  Given Reseam Manager is installed
  And BaconReader Premium is patched with the BaconReader patches 0.1.19 by Reseam Manager
  And the BaconReader patches 0.1.20 are released
  And BaconReader is open
  When I open the left menu
  Then the bottom of the left menu shows "Patches 0.1.19 (Reseam 0.40.0)"
  When I open Reseam Manager
  And I tap "BaconReader Premium" under "Patched apps"
  And I tap "Patch again"
  Then Reseam Manager shows "BaconReader Premium is ready"
  When I tap "Install"
  And I tap "Update" on "Update this app?"
  And I tap "Open"
  And I open the left menu
  Then the bottom of the left menu shows "Patches 0.1.20 (Reseam 0.40.0)"
